Operational Description

Body Computer M001, receives an INT (Key-on) signal at pin 9 of connector H, when it brings about - via an earth signal - excitation of the coil of service relay R13 that supplies boot control unit M063 (pin 9 of connector C) and all associated funcion loads via a line protected by fuse F45 of underfacia junction unit B002.

Head restraint unit foldaway control switch H063 is connected to pin 8 of connector D of boot control unit M063; the control unit, which is supplied by a line protected by fuse F61 inside boot control unit B045, turns on the three head restraint foldaway motors (central N120, right N121 and left N122) from pin 8 of connector A.
